verses.text: In front of God and Christ Jesus, I give you this command. Christ Jesus will judge the living and the dead when he appears and his kingdom comes.
Preach the message. Be ready at all times, whether it is easy or not. Correct people, warn them and encourage them, with great patience and careful teaching.
The time will come when people will not listen to healthy teaching. Instead, they will gather many teachers around them to say what their itching ears want to hear, to suit their own desires.
They will stop listening to the truth and turn to myths.
But you, keep a clear head in every situation. Put up with hardship. Do the work of telling the Good News, and do all the work God has given you.
As for me, my life is already being poured out like a drink offering, and the time for me to leave this life has come.
I have fought the good fight. I have finished the race. I have kept the faith.

Now the crown for doing right is waiting for me. The Lord, the judge who is always fair, will give it to me on that day. And he will give it not only to me, but also to all who have longed for him to appear.
Do your best to come to me soon.
Demas has left me, because he loved this world. He has gone to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.
Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, because he is a help to me in my work.
I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
When you come, bring the coat I left with Carpus in Troas. Bring my scrolls too, and most of all the parchments.
Alexander the metalworker did me a lot of harm. The Lord will pay him back for what he has done.
You too should watch out for him, because he strongly opposed our message.
The first time I had to defend myself in court, no one came to help me. Everyone left me. May it not be held against them.
But the Lord stood by me and gave me strength, so that through me the message could be fully preached and all the Gentiles could hear it. And I was rescued from the lion's mouth.
The Lord will rescue me from every evil attack and bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. To him be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
Greet Priscilla and Aquila, and the family of Onesiphorus.
Erastus stayed in Corinth. I left Trophimus sick in Miletus.
Do your best to get here before winter. Eubulus greets you, and so do Pudens, Linus, Claudia and all the brothers and sisters.
The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
